issues.description: `Course.addRating(stars:)` has inconsistent return types across artifacts: the problem statement and template specify/declare it as a void method, but the reference solution implements it as `-> Bool`. This can confuse learners and may break signature-based tests expecting the template/statement API.
issues.suggestedFix: Pick one API and make all artifacts match. Easiest: change the solution signature to `func addRating(stars: Int)` (no return) and remove the Bool returns. If a Bool is intended, update the problem statement and the template stub to `func addRating(stars: Int) -> Bool` and document true/false meaning.
